entries.author: mike
entries.summary: All 4 plan steps completed on branch bugfix/coffer-alert-text-only; ./gradlew compileJava succeeded.
entries.detail: AlertsApiClient.sendAlert() split into a text-only overload and the existing image-carrying overload, both sharing one request-building/response-handling path (addresses WRN-005 by not adding a third duplicate rather than by fixing the existing duplication). CofferAlertListener no longer depends on ScreenshotCapture and calls the text-only overload directly; its class Javadoc was updated to match (screenshot -> text-only) as part of the same step, not logged separately since it's a direct consequence of the code change in the same file. README.md's Discord alerts section updated to describe the coffer text-only behavior and flag the still-outstanding catabot-side companion change (optional image for kind=coffer, drop the observer-RSN prefix for coffer). No live game session available in this environment - in-game confirmation that the coffer message posts correctly (and that loot/death are unaffected) is still on the developer before shipping, consistent with how the original feature was verified.

entries.author: system
entries.detail: Definition of done, concerns check, and Dev UAT checklist all confirmed by developer. Notably, the catabot-side companion dependency (image optional for kind=coffer, no RSN prefix for coffer) was checked during this verification and found already merged and pushed to catabot's origin/main (commit 2c886d4, task coffer-alerts-image-rsn-fix), so no shipping-order risk remains.
